name: Avatar
layerWhy: It stands for a person or one thing; no job.
promise: This is who or what it is.
evidence: Its name is what is read; initials stand in when the picture is missing or fails.
context: Beside a name, in a list, in a bar.
relationships: It goes with the person's name nearby.
accessibility: role="img" with the name; the initials are hidden from reading.
failures: Never the only place a name appears.
dont: An avatar for a non-person object with a person's look.
